Twenty arms on track-p 13151fb5: ctl and one dial at a time, each a hypothesis in the parameter docs: explore_mix_radius 3 and 8 (shipped 5), explore_mix_step 1 and 4 (2), every class's explore_mix_max_clevel +3 and -2 (shipped per class: Warrior 3, Mage 6, Druid 5, Priest 7, Necromancer 7, Paladin 6, Rogue 4, Ranger 5, Blackguard 4), flow_leash_recall_max_level 8 (5), flow_leash_recall_steps 15 and 60 (30), trap_disarm_min_percent 25 and 75 (50), trap_disarm_max_tries 3 (10), trap_leave_near_count 2 (0), stair_scum_speed_ratio 1 and 3 (2), stair_scum_alarm_turns 0 and 300 (100), item_test_unknown_hold_turns 0 and 360 (180). A pilot only: the arms whose plays differ from ctl go on to a ladder on the owner's word; an arm that plays ctl's keys in all 18 games was not exercised.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, evidence retained.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (an arm that plays ctl's keys was not exercised). Report per arm against ctl: deaths and causes (exact McNemar), deaths at CL <= 2, DL3 and DL5 reached, mean CL, per class. Descriptive (RULES 14).
